card.name: Numbers where a weight value is expected
card.fires_on: The number, or the space just before it, that gives a weight value: molecular weight after MW=, atomic weights in old chemistry text, or body weight in kg.

modes.label: Molecular weight value
modes.description: The equals sign or digits right after MW in a chemical name entry.

modes.label: Atomic weight after weighing
modes.description: The space before a number after words like weighing or weigh in old chemistry text.

modes.label: Body weight in kg
modes.description: A digit in a patient weight used in a dose calculation.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word weight or a weight unit such as kg.
card.plain: It fires on the number slot where a weight, such as molecular weight or body weight in kg, is about to be given.
